# Build an updater image that reports the kernel-enforced security state.
exec docker build -qt runtime-security-updater .

# Normal updater execution has no capabilities and enforces both NNP and seccomp.
dependabot update go_modules test/repo --updater-image runtime-security-updater
stderr 'runtime-security flow=normal capeff=0000000000000000 nonewprivs=1 seccomp=2'

# Local staging remains writable without granting capabilities to the updater.
dependabot update go_modules test/repo --updater-image runtime-security-updater --local my-repo
stderr 'runtime-security flow=local capeff=0000000000000000 nonewprivs=1 seccomp=2'
stderr 'local staging is writable'

exec docker rmi -f runtime-security-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:22.04

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd -m dependabot \
    && mkdir -p /home/dependabot/dependabot-updater \
    && chown dependabot:dependabot /home/dependabot/dependabot-updater

COPY --chown=dependabot update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot print-security /usr/local/bin/print-security
COPY --chown=dependabot run /bin/run
RUN chmod 0755 /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates /usr/local/bin/print-security /bin/run

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

echo "Updated certificates"

-- print-security --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

cap_eff=$(awk '$1 == "CapEff:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
no_new_privs=$(awk '$1 == "NoNewPrivs:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
seccomp=$(awk '$1 == "Seccomp:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
echo "runtime-security flow=$1 capeff=$cap_eff nonewprivs=$no_new_privs seccomp=$seccomp"

-- run --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

flow=normal
if [ -f "$DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH/local.txt" ]; then
  flow=local
  printf '%s\n' "updated" >> "$DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH/local.txt"
  echo "local staging is writable"
fi
print-security "$flow"

-- my-repo/local.txt --
local source
